<div class="ref-table">

| Attribute and property | What it does |
|---|---|
| `definition` | The form being edited; reading returns it as authored. Refused (datum-error, nothing replaced) while a src fetch is still loading: clear src first.<br>**Takes** JSON of a form definition. **Default** empty form. |
| `src` | Fetched on connect; a later src replaces a form an earlier one brought. Refused (datum-error, nothing fetched) while a definition the page assigned, or one New or Open brought, is in place: clear definition first. While it loads, an assigned definition, New and Open are refused; a response that arrives after the author edited is not loaded over the edits (datum-warning src.superseded). A response longer than max-definition-bytes is refused before it is parsed.<br>**Takes** URL of a definition. **Default** none. |
| `max-definition-bytes`<br>`maxDefinitionBytes` | The longest definition read from src or the Open file action, in UTF-8 bytes, the cap every other import has; a longer one is refused before it is parsed. Anything but a whole number above 0 is reported and the cap stays.<br>**Takes** whole number of bytes. **Default** 2097152 (2 MiB). |
| `theme` | The builder's own look: an id the host registers, default (the built-in light look), or the built-in dark one, datum-dark, which counts as the dark scheme unless the author remembered a choice or the page sets scheme.<br>**Takes** builder theme id. **Default** default. |
| `load-fonts`<br>`loadFonts` | Loads the builder's own fonts (Geist and Geist Mono) from beside the bundle. A binding's files come through the assets property.<br>**Takes** boolean attribute. **Default** off. |
| `debug`<br>attribute only | Logs journey diagnostics to the console.<br>**Takes** boolean attribute. **Default** off. |
| `pdf-theme`<br>`pdfTheme` | The theme the PDF preview is drawn with.<br>**Takes** PDF theme id. **Default** default. |
| `layout` | contained fills its parent's box with % heights.<br>**Takes** page \| contained. **Default** page. |
| `locale` | The locale the canvas and inspector resolve labels in.<br>**Takes** BCP 47 tag. **Default** the form's default locale. |
| `data-sources`<br>`dataSources` | Sources the Data workspace and canvas can use.<br>**Takes** JSON of a data source set. **Default** none. |
| `data-source-ids`<br>`dataSourceIds` | Ids the Data workspace offers when the sources themselves are not given.<br>**Takes** space or comma list of ids. **Default** none. |
| `validation-codes`<br>`validationCodes` | Server-side codes the Logic workspace can name.<br>**Takes** JSON list of host validation codes. **Default** none. |
| `component-types`<br>`componentTypeFilter` | Restricts the palette. Exclusions win over inclusions. The componentTypes property is a different thing (custom types).<br>**Takes** space or comma list of types; a leading - drops a type, a trailing * matches a prefix. **Default** every type. |
| `pdf` | Default ON: the executor is fetched as a chunk of this bundle on the first preview. off removes the PDF mode and the PDF seed. A page-built executor is the pdfSupport property. Held to the page's origin: a URL on another origin is reported as datum-error and the attribute is treated as absent (auto), unless allow-origins lists that origin; the property may name any.<br>**Takes** auto \| off \| URL of the PDF module. **Default** auto (on). |
| `pdf-pages`<br>`pdfPages` | Where the page imagery for template areas loads from; off draws on blank sheets. A template resolver is the pdfTemplates property. Held to the page's origin: a URL on another origin is reported as datum-error and the attribute is treated as absent (auto), unless allow-origins lists that origin; the property may name any.<br>**Takes** auto \| off \| URL. **Default** auto. |
| `pdf-integrity`<br>`pdfIntegrity` | Holds the PDF executor to a hash: the module pdf names, or for auto datum-pdf.js beside the bundle in place of the bundle's own chunk, is fetched, its bytes checked, and those bytes imported from a blob: URL (list blob: in script-src under a Content Security Policy), on every load and retry. A module that does not match is never run, and the preview or download fails saying why.<br>**Takes** sha256-, sha384- or sha512- digests, space-separated. **Default** unset. |
| `pdf-pages-integrity`<br>`pdfPagesIntegrity` | Holds the page imagery to a hash: the module pdf-pages names, or datum-pdf-pages.js beside the PDF module, is fetched, checked and imported from a blob: URL. One that does not match is never run and the area editor draws blank sheets, saying why.<br>**Takes** sha256-, sha384- or sha512- digests, space-separated. **Default** unset. |
| `pdf-manifest`<br>`pdfManifest` | Where the package's integrity manifest is; read only with pdf-manifest-integrity. Resolved against the page when set. Not held to the page's origin: the file is held to a hash.<br>**Takes** auto \| URL of integrity.json. **Default** auto: ../integrity.json from the PDF module (the npm package's layout, as the CDNs serve it). |
| `pdf-manifest-integrity`<br>`pdfManifestIntegrity` | Holds integrity.json to a hash, then every file the PDF modules fetch to the hash it lists: the fonts, the pdf.js worker (started from a blob: URL, so list blob: in worker-src), its standard fonts, CMaps and wasm image decoders. A file it does not list or whose bytes differ is refused. pdf.js's ICC profiles and its decoders' JavaScript fallbacks have no hook and are not loaded in this mode.<br>**Takes** sha256-, sha384- or sha512- digests, space-separated. **Default** unset (the files are fetched unchecked). |
| `journeys` | Default ON. off removes the Journeys mode; the definition's journeys pass through untouched.<br>**Takes** auto \| off. **Default** auto (on). |
| `values` | Seeds Try it.<br>**Takes** JSON of sample answers. **Default** none. |
| `translations` | The host's catalog: the previews use it, and the Languages workspace shows the texts it overrides read-only. The form's own translations are the definition's translations map, edited in the Languages workspace.<br>**Takes** JSON of a translation catalog: locale, then kind (form, components, chrome, journeys, pdf), then the owner's id, then the property tree, with string leaves. **Default** none. |
| `mode` | The builder mode shown first; setMode() changes it.<br>**Takes** form \| pdf \| journeys. **Default** form. |
| `persist-panels`<br>`persistPanels` | Remembers which panels are open under this key.<br>**Takes** storage key. **Default** off. |
| `file-actions`<br>`fileActions` | Which of the builder's own file actions show. Save is not one of them: save or the fileActions property turns it on, whatever this names.<br>**Takes** auto \| none \| off \| space or comma list of new, open, download. **Default** all three. |
| `save` | Puts Save in the ⋮ menu and on Ctrl/Cmd+S. Choosing it asks about an edit still in the inspector, then fires datum-builder-save with the definition. Bare, it sends nothing: the page stores the form in a listener and hands the work to detail.waitUntil(promise), so the item reads Saving… until it settles and a rejection's message shows beside the menu. With an address (save="/api/forms/x"), the builder also sends the form there itself: the definition as JSON (content-type application/json) by save-method, any 2xx answer counting as saved, anything else, an unreachable server or 30 seconds without an answer shown beside the menu as the reason it was not saved; detail.waitUntil(promise) has the request wait on the page's own work, and preventDefault() leaves the request out. Relative URLs read against the page. The address is held to the page's origin: a URL on another origin is reported as datum-error and the attribute is treated as absent, unless allow-origins lists that origin; the property may name any. Once it succeeds the form as sent is the saved one (dirty clears). A request that needs headers of its own, credentials on another origin or a revision check is a bare save with a listener, or the fileActions.save function; a fileActions.save function wins over this attribute. The property is false, true (bare) or the address.<br>**Takes** boolean attribute \| URL. **Default** off. |
| `save-method`<br>`saveMethod` | The request an address in save is sent by. Any other word is reported as datum-error and the method stays.<br>**Takes** PUT \| POST. **Default** PUT. |
| `save-label`<br>`saveLabel` | Save's name in the ⋮ menu (Save draft, Publish), whichever Save it is; a fileActions.saveLabel wins.<br>**Takes** text. **Default** Save. |
| `workspace` | The workspace shown first; setWorkspace() switches through the unsaved-edits guard.<br>**Takes** form \| logic \| data \| languages \| journeys \| pdf \| print. **Default** form. |
| `workspaces` | The only workspaces the bar offers; hidden-workspaces, pdf, journeys and features still take away from it. A list of pdf or journeys alone is that designer on its own: the builder opens on it, the form's documents leave the bar, and a loading card stands in until its code is in. It does not remove the other workspaces' code.<br>**Takes** space or comma list of workspaces. **Default** absent: every workspace. |
| `hidden-workspaces`<br>`hiddenWorkspaces` | Leaves workspaces off the bar. It does not remove their code.<br>**Takes** space or comma list of workspaces. **Default** none hidden. |
| `layout-id`<br>`layoutId` | Which of the definition's PDF layouts is on the page in the PDF workspace.<br>**Takes** layout id. **Default** the definition's default layout, else the first. |
| `hidden-panels`<br>`hiddenPanels` | Leaves strip panels off, as hidden-workspaces does workspaces; works with or without features, which it can only restrict. A hidden panel is never loaded and never the open one, remembered or not: the workspace's own opens instead.<br>**Takes** space or comma list of panel ids: form, chrome, components, fields, outline, variables, tests, view, settings. **Default** none hidden. |
| `managed-settings`<br>`managedSettings` | Settings the host owns: the inspector shows Managed by the site. in place of each box and never touches the stored value.<br>**Takes** space or comma list of inspector property paths, or answersFree for data.answersFree. **Default** none managed. |
| `features` | Present means only the listed parts exist, besides the Form workspace with its canvas, inspector and component palette; minimal is that alone, so minimal logic is the form plus Logic. The list is the master: pdf, journeys, hidden-workspaces, hidden-panels, component-types and file-actions can only take more away, and a pdf or journeys that asks for a side the list omits is ignored with one console warning, as is a workspace for one (the form opens). translations is the pointer line under a component's texts, which says how much of it each language has and opens the Languages workspace on it, tests the Tests panel, print the Print workspace (the form's print settings beside a preview of the printed form, a lazy chunk), json the JSON view and editor, binding-picker the binding picker (the binding property still sets the binding), advanced-fields the inspector's component id and data key. agent is opt-in: not part of all; write all agent to add it (the agent tools over the builder, a lazy chunk: twenty-four tools besides the session pair). A part that is left out fetches none of its chunks. A word with a minus in front takes that part out: all -pdf is every part but the PDF side, and so is -pdf alone, since a list of only exclusions starts from all; an exclusion wins wherever it stands. A word that names nothing (a mistyped exclusion included) is reported as datum-error and left out, and a list holding one never starts from all. Changing it after connect rebuilds the sides, workspaces, strip, bar and inspector, except an agent-only change, which only registers or withdraws the agent tools.<br>**Takes** space or comma list of logic, data, languages, translations, journeys, pdf, print, variables, header-footer, data-model, palette, try-it, tests, json, binding-picker, advanced-fields, agent; presets all, minimal; -name leaves one out. **Default** absent: every feature but agent. |
| `full-window`<br>`fullWindow` | Present: the builder covers the whole browser window; the bar's button toggles it.<br>**Takes** boolean attribute. **Default** off. |
| `no-full-window`<br>attribute only | Removes the bar's full-window control.<br>**Takes** boolean attribute. **Default** off. |
| `scheme` | The builder's own colour scheme: dark applies the studio look's dark palette to the shell, every panel and every workspace surface (Logic, Data, Languages, the overviews, the command palette), as theme="datum-dark" does. The ⋮ menu's Dark mode switch changes it and remembers the choice under localStorage; an attribute set by the page wins over the memory. While dark, the form on the canvas is drawn in Datum's dark look, or under the dark variant of the design-system binding it is drawn with where that binding names one; a binding that names none stays a light form on a white sheet.<br>**Takes** light \| dark. **Default** light, or the scheme the author last chose from the ⋮ menu on this origin. |
| `no-scheme-toggle`<br>attribute only | Removes Dark mode from the ⋮ menu; scheme still sets the look.<br>**Takes** boolean attribute. **Default** off. |
| `wasm` | The sandbox Try it validates with; nothing is fetched until the author turns the validator on in Try it. A serverChecks property wins over it. Held to the page's origin: a URL on another origin is reported as datum-error and the attribute is treated as absent (auto), unless allow-origins lists that origin; the property may name any.<br>**Takes** auto \| off \| URL of the sandbox module. **Default** auto. |
| `wasm-integrity`<br>`wasmIntegrity` | Holds the sandbox module wasm names to a hash, as the form's wasm-integrity does: fetched, checked, and imported from a blob: URL (list blob: in script-src under a Content Security Policy). A module that does not match is never run, and Try it says the validator is unavailable.<br>**Takes** sha256-, sha384- or sha512- digests, space-separated. **Default** unset. |
| `allow-origins`<br>attribute only | The other origins the wasm, pdf, pdf-pages and save attributes may name. A word that names no origin (*, a bare host) is reported as datum-error and left out. Changing it applies an attribute it now allows and drops one it no longer does.<br>**Takes** space-separated origins, each written as a URL (https://cdn.example). **Default** none: the page's own origin only. |
| `leave-guard`<br>attribute only | Leaving the page with unsaved work (a reload, a link, a closed tab) has the browser ask first, in its own words: the form differs from the saved one, or an edit is still held in a panel. off leaves that to a page that keeps the work some other way. Read when the page is about to go, so it can change at any time.<br>**Takes** on \| off. **Default** on. |
